stage: Recovery-V1: diagnosis of the residual failures of the Vision-V1 base policy

authorization.proposed_cap_is: a proposal by the user, explicitly not an approval; earlier approvals are not inherited
authorization.required_file: authorization.json in the run folder: {"approved_by": "user", "paid_compute_authorized": true, "cap_usd": <number>, "plan_sha256": "<sha256 of this plan>"}

question: By which mechanism do the remaining episodes of the frozen Vision-V1 policy fail, and which single mechanism is the most frequent?

base_policy.rule: frozen; not retrained, not fine-tuned, no other checkpoint

existing_traces.vision_v1_per_episode_files: seed, success_once, steps, end reason, policy calls, timing, furthest stage only
existing_traces.per_step_trace_of_the_new_policy: none was stored in Vision-V1 (the stage label was computed in memory and the trace discarded)
missing: executed actions and gripper command per step
cube poses, tilt and velocities per step
time and pose of the release
whether the success pose was reached while still grasped
existing_traces.decision: a new diagnostic pass is needed; vision_v1_select / vision_v1_qualify are not re-run for it (3 select scenes are re-run by `probe` for timing only)

seed_manifest.reserved: recovery_v1_pilot_reserved (50700-50799) is declared so that no other work takes it; no command of this work resets or runs it
seed_manifest.seed_level_check: no overlap with splits.json, policy_eval_splits.json, vision_v1_splits.json, the 550 demonstration scene seeds, or the scenes of Stage 2A / 2B / 2D / H1
seed_manifest.placement_check: server step `scenes`: cube placements of the 100 diagnostic seeds against stored placements (demonstrations, pilots) and, by reset, against audit / dev / policy-evaluation / Vision-V1 sets; calibration and Test by seed number only. An identical placement fails the step

per_step: cubeA and cubeB position, orientation, linear and angular velocity
task flags: grasped, cubeA on cubeB, static, success
contact force magnitude: cubeA-cubeB, cubeA-each finger, cubeA-table, cubeB-each finger
recording.frames: both policy cameras at every step, stored for failed episodes only (diagnostic evidence; the success flag decides storage, not any policy input)
recording.privileged: all of it is simulator ground truth, written to files after each step; the policy receives exactly the Vision-V1 observation and nothing from the recorder

labels.NO_APPROACH: the gripper never came within 3 cm of cubeA
labels.NO_GRASP: near cubeA, grasp flag never true
labels.GRASP_NOT_LIFTED: grasp flag true, cubeA never lifted 1 cm while grasped
labels.NOT_RELEASED_AT_PLACE: cubeA was in the success pose on cubeB while still grasped and the episode ended with the grasp still on (did not let go)
labels.HOLDING_NOT_PLACED: episode ended still holding cubeA, which was never in the success pose during that hold
labels.GRASP_LOST_WITHOUT_OPEN_COMMAND: the lifted cube left the grasp while the gripper command was still "close" (slip or knock)
labels.RELEASE_OFF_TARGET_XY: commanded release with cubeA outside the horizontal tolerance over cubeB (position error)
labels.EARLY_RELEASE_ABOVE: commanded release horizontally over cubeB but higher than the resting height (opened too early, dropped)
labels.RELEASE_BELOW_REST_HEIGHT: commanded release horizontally over cubeB but lower than the resting height (pressed in or tilted)
labels.POST_RELEASE_UNSTABLE: released in the success pose, then cubeA left that pose (instability after contact)
labels.IN_PLACE_NOT_STATIC: released in the success pose and stayed there, never static at a released step
labels.UNKNOWN: no rule applies; the cause is not established by the log

classification.frozen: rules and thresholds are fixed by the hash of src/hci/recovery_v1.py in this plan, before any diagnostic episode. A rule changed after seeing traces is reported as post hoc
classification.unknown: an episode no rule explains is UNKNOWN; it is counted, not forced into a label

probe.purpose: recorder works on this host; seconds per control step; does the run reproduce the recorded success and step count
probe.reproduction_rule: a difference from the record is reported and does not block (another GPU may change floating-point results); a recorder error blocks

run.ledger: artifacts/ledger/recovery_v1_diag.json, created exclusively before any rollout; no resume, no second pass
run.on_error: the pass stops and stays INCOMPLETE; no episode is dropped or replaced

outputs_after_the_run: counts and cases per mechanism label with the log evidence of every verdict
ONE proposed local recovery action for the most frequent mechanism (not a repeat of the 5 cm retreat by default)

a controlled pilot plan: C0 (no intervention), R5 (existing 5 cm retreat) and the new action from the same state with the same noise keys, on recovery_v1_pilot_reserved, triggered by a rule that does not use the outcome
projected GPU cost of that pilot

pilot_design_constraints.same_state: branches start from one snapshot restored by prefix action replay (hci.simulation.restore_env), same scene seed
pilot_design_constraints.same_noise: policy noise keyed by seed_for(scene, physical step, repeat, 'dp') as in every earlier pilot
pilot_design_constraints.selection_of_states: a trigger computed from quantities available at the decision step, fixed before the pilot; never chosen from the known outcome of the continuation
pilot_design_constraints.status: constraints only; the action and the trigger are written after the diagnosis and need their own approval

cost_estimate.basis: Vision-V1 run 2, RTX 4090 at US$0.4539/h: 19 s per episode on vision_v1_select with the same policy (1.1 s per policy call)
cost_estimate.gate: the server `budget` step projects the total from the measured seconds per step at the full 200 steps for every episode and refuses above the approved cap
